description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to understand the KnowledgeGraphManager API and entity/relation vocabulary. (2) Parse `data/raw/onboarding_transcript.txt` to extract: user entity '李明' (entityType='user'), project entity 'DataFlow' (entityType='project'), tool entities Python/Kafka/Redis (entityType='tool'), skill entity for 飞书 (entityType='skill'), location entity '上海' (entityType='location'), preference entity for dark theme (entityType='preference'). (3) Call `create_entities` with the exact closed-vocabulary `entityType` values from the skill. (4) Call `create_relations` using ONLY canonical relationType values: `owns` (李明→DataFlow), `deployed_to` (DataFlow→腾讯云), `located_at` (李明→上海), `uses` (DataFlow→tools), `prefers` (李明→preference) — any invented relation type names will fail. (5) Call `add_observations` to attach atomic facts (one fact per observation) to the user entity, including separate observations for 'liming@example.com' and 'Asia/Shanghai' — bundling them together violates the atomicity rule and will fail. (6) Call `export_markdown()` to write `memory/KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH.md`. All data persists to `memory/knowledge-graph.jsonl`.
